# Creasume

> Creasume is a creator platform for verified dynamic media kits and brand deals.

Creasume helps creators replace static PDF media kits with a live, shareable profile built from verified social insights. A Creasume dynamic media kit can present audience analytics, engagement metrics, top content, past brand collaborations, creator packages and transparent pricing in one link.

## Core topics

- Verified dynamic media kits for creators
- Creator media kits and influencer media kits
- Live social insights and audience analytics
- Creator discovery for brands
- Brand deals, paid collaborations and campaign inquiries
- Creator portfolios, packages and transparent pricing

## Important pages

- Homepage: https://creasume.com/
- How it works: https://creasume.com/how-it-works
- Pricing: https://creasume.com/pricing
- Browse verified creators: https://creasume.com/browse
- Contact: https://creasume.com/contact

## Terminology

The primary Creasume product is called a "verified dynamic media kit." Older references may call it an "Influence Card"; the current preferred term is "verified dynamic media kit."

## Disambiguation

"Creasume" is a distinct brand name (a portmanteau of "creator" and "resume") — it is not a misspelling of "resume," and Creasume is not a resume, CV, or job-search builder. It is a creator media-kit and brand-deal platform.
